# Floating UI browser modules

Official npm releases, retrieved 2026-10-17. Tarballs were checked against npm registry SHA-512 integrity before extracting. Versions, URLs, original SHA-256 and local SHA-256 are recorded in provenance.json.

Only bare module import/export specifiers were changed to adjacent local .mjs paths; implementation bytes otherwise remain upstream. Each package MIT license is retained separately. No install scripts run; no runtime CDN.

Documentation: https://floating-ui.com/docs/computePosition, https://floating-ui.com/docs/autoUpdate, https://floating-ui.com/docs/size.
